MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The flat washer assortment complements my recent metric screws and nuts, giving me matching parts for fastening jobs.",
    "The magnets connect to my recent hanging purchases, and the caliper could help size screws and washers, so both relate to practical tasks I recognize."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Wire connectors, battery terminals and resistors require electrical projects I have not shown a need for; buying screws does not mean I am working on wiring.",
    "Metal drill bits and a large woodworking glue refill introduce tasks I am not currently doing.",
    "More magnets feel less urgent after my recent magnetic hook purchases, while a caliper is something I would wait to buy until a measurement task comes up."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations treat workshop supplies as interchangeable, although fastening, hanging, wiring and woodworking serve different needs for me.",
    "Several suggestions seem to assume that buying an assortment of hardware means I also want assortments of unrelated electrical parts."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Compatibility with my recent purchases matters: assorted metric flat washers have a clear use alongside my screws and nuts.",
    "Recent purchases can mean a need is already covered; my magnetic hooks make another magnet purchase less pressing.",
    "I rarely act without a concrete use, so something that might eventually be useful is less compelling than a part that completes what I already have."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my fastening and hanging needs but stretched that interest into unrelated workshop and electrical projects."
}
